The case

Seven locks

  1. 1Crossword: words built from roots.
  2. 2Scrambled roots: unscramble seven roots.
  3. 3Secret message: crack the code to find a hidden root.
  4. 4Match the roots: give each root its meaning.
  5. 5Build the word: put two roots together to make a word.
  6. 6Odd one out: spot the word that only looks like it has the root.
  7. 7The last lock: use the roots you collected to solve the case.

Spelling counts, but capital letters don't. You can try as many times as you like.
